Hôtel et Garderie Aristopattes is truly exceptional! Kami took amazing care of my dog, and I couldn’t be more grateful. From the start, it was clear how passionate and dedicated she is. My dog was treated like family the entire time.

The space is spotless, cozy, and clearly designed with the well-being of the animals in mind. Kami kept me updated throughout my dog stay, which gave me real peace of mind. It’s rare to find someone who genuinely loves what they do, and it shows in every detail.

If you’re looking for a safe, loving, and professional place for your pet, I highly recommend Aristopattes. Thank you again, Kami—you’re the best! 🐶🐾
